text:
Augustus III of Poland bought Correggio’s *The Adoration of the Shepherds*, known as *La Notte* (*The Holy Night*), in 1746 from Francesco III d’Este, Duke of Modena. The same purchase brought three other Correggio altarpieces to Dresden: the *Madonna of St. Francis*, the *Madonna of St. Sebastian*, and the *Madonna of St. George*. *La Notte*, painted about 1528–1530, is in the Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister.
